title: 第十七章  两年后
content_zh:
两年时光一晃而逝，在死亡山脉外围中长达两年枯燥的修炼，琼霄的修为已经到了*境后期，在达到*境后期巅峰的日子里，他隐隐约约有着突破的迹象，可不管他怎么努力总是他不出这一步。

    离入学考试的时间越来越紧，琼霄不得不放弃苦修，离开死亡山脉。

    “两年了，星辰学院，我琼霄就要来了！”此刻琼霄早已醒来，站在高处的他望着死亡山脉外面的世界呢喃道。

    两年前，琼霄十四岁，十四岁对于很多人来说，那是一个在家里人呵护下，开心成长的季节，但琼霄没有福气，十四岁的他为了能进入星辰学院，毅然决然独自一人离开自己住了十四年的小山村，离开了那位年迈的老者，前往充满了危险的死亡山脉修行。因为星辰学院录取资格极为严格，它录取的学生必须在十六岁到十九岁之间，修为必须要进入*境，否则没有资格参加学院入学考试，要想进入星辰学院，就必须达到*境。如果一直在山村内，他恐怕没有任何机会进入星辰学院，一旦进去不了星辰学院，那么就没有机会查清诸葛一族灭族原因，就没有任何机会为诸葛一族报仇！

    回想着当年灭门的惨剧，琼霄双手紧紧握了起来，“我一定要进入星辰学院！”琼霄目光坚定望着外面的世界。

    一切收拾完毕，琼霄背起重剑离开了山洞，走出洞外的琼霄回头看了自己住了快两年的山洞，有些不舍起来，呆呆的站了一小会儿，“是时候该走了，我住了两年的地方，再见！”琼霄甩开了心中有些不舍的情绪随即转身往前方走去。

    天越来越亮，初阳抚摸着大地，万事万物都已开始了新一天的生活，而琼霄已经在前往外面世界的路上。

    寂静的树林之中，一道身影不停的穿梭着，破风的声音随着琼霄的飞驰而回荡在在死亡山脉的上空。两年的修行，不停的在与死亡搏斗，两年里，琼霄不知受了多少伤，连他自己也不知道，死在他手中的魔兽早已上百，其中不缺乏比紫金苍狼和地黄狮更强的魔兽，长年累月的修行，使得琼霄的身体抗打大幅度增加，体内的星力也越发的浑厚，体内的星力比寻常的*境后期强者还强上一线。有了足够强悍的体质和足够的星力坐后盾，琼霄不停地在树林里穿梭着，丝毫没有停下脚步的意思，仿佛要一鼓作气冲出死亡山脉一般……

    数个时辰之后，琼霄站在死亡山脉的外面，深深的吸了一口气，而后重重呼了出来，“哈哈，两年了，我琼霄终于出来了，”此刻的琼霄大笑了起来。

    走出了死亡山脉，琼霄的心情格外的好，他现在只想好好的去吃一顿，感受一下浓厚的人类气息。两年里除了杜狼和范森一伙人，琼霄再也没有见过任何人，整日待在死亡山脉之中与魔兽周旋，他都快与外面的世界脱节了，离开了死亡山脉，琼霄踏入了大路上，不停的朝着集市里走去，速度越来越快，隐约有着一丝连走带跑的意思。

    走到集市里，琼霄又来到了两年前他吃饭的地方，在这里可以找的到他的足记，坐在他以前坐的位置，他微微一笑旋即开口道：“小二，点菜！”

    “好咧，小的立马就到，”店小二回应道。

    “客官，你要吃点什么？”店小二问道。

    “把你店里的招牌菜给我全都上了，”琼霄看着店小二说道，然后随手一翻一枚金币丢给了店小二又说道：“这是给你的，去吧。”

    接到金币的店小二开心道：“好咧，我现在就去。”

    店小二毛巾往肩上一甩，随即转身喊道：“这位要本店所有的招牌菜！”

    ……
content_en:
Two years passed by in a flash. After two years of boring training on the outskirts of the Death Mountain, Qiong Xiao's cultivation had reached the late stage. In the days when he reached the peak of the late stage, he had vague signs of a breakthrough, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not make it this far.

The time before the entrance exam was getting closer and closer, and Qiong Xiao had to give up his hard work and leave the Death Mountain.

"It's been two years, Xingchen Academy, I, Qiong Xiao, am coming!" At this moment, Qiong Xiao had already woken up, and standing on a high place, he murmured as he looked at the world outside the Death Mountain.

Two years ago, Qiong Xiao was fourteen years old. For many people, fourteen years old is a season of growing up happily under the care of family members. However, Qiong Xiao was not blessed. In order to enter Star Academy, at the age of fourteen, he resolutely left the small mountain village where he had lived for fourteen years, left the old man, and went to practice in the Death Mountains, which is full of dangers.Because the admission qualifications for Star Academy are extremely strict, the students it admits must be between the ages of sixteen and nineteen, and their cultivation must reach the * level, otherwise they are not eligible to take the college entrance exam. To enter Star Academy, they must reach the * level.If he had stayed in the mountain village, he might not have any chance of entering Star Academy. Once he could not enter Star Academy, he would have no chance to find out the reason for the annihilation of the Zhuge clan, and there would be no chance to avenge the Zhuge clan!

Recalling the tragedy of annihilating the family, Qiong Xiao clenched her hands tightly, "I must enter Star Academy!" Qiong Xiao looked firmly at the outside world.

After everything was cleaned up, Qiong Xiao picked up the heavy sword and left the cave. After walking out of the cave, Qiong Xiao looked back at the cave where she had lived for almost two years. She felt a little reluctant to leave it and stood blankly for a while. "It's time to leave. This is the place where I lived for two years. Goodbye!" Qiong Xiao shook off the reluctance in her heart and then turned and walked forward.

The sky is getting brighter and brighter, the early sun is caressing the earth, everything has begun a new day of life, and Qiong Xiao is already on the way to the outside world.

In the silent woods, a figure kept shuttling back and forth, and the sound of breaking wind echoed in the sky above the Death Mountains as Qiong Xiao flew by.After two years of practice, he was constantly fighting against death. In the two years, Qiong Xiao had no idea how many injuries he had suffered. Even he himself did not know that hundreds of monsters had died in his hands, including many monsters stronger than the Purple Gold Wolf and the Earth Yellow Lion. Years of practice had greatly increased Qiong Xiao's physical resistance to attack, and the star power in his body had become stronger and stronger. The star power in his body was stronger than ordinary late stage powerhouses.With a strong enough physique and enough star power to back him up, Qiong Xiao kept shuttling through the woods without any intention of stopping, as if he was going to rush out of the Death Mountains in one go...

A few hours later, Qiong Xiao stood outside the Death Mountain, took a deep breath, and then exhaled heavily, "Haha, after two years, I, Qiong Xiao, finally came out," Qiong Xiao laughed at this moment.

After walking out of the Death Mountain, Qiong Xiao was in a particularly good mood. Now he just wanted to have a good meal and feel the strong human atmosphere.In the past two years, Qiong Xiao had never seen anyone except Du Lang and Fan Sen. He stayed in the Death Mountains and dealt with monsters all day long. He was almost out of touch with the outside world. After leaving the Death Mountains, Qiong Xiao stepped onto the road and kept walking towards the market. His speed was getting faster and faster, with a hint of walking and running.

Walking to the market, Qiong Xiao came to the place where he ate two years ago. His footprints can be found here. Sitting where he used to sit, he smiled slightly and said: "Waiter, order!"

"Okay, I'll be here soon," the waiter responded.

"Sir, what would you like to eat?" the waiter asked.

"Serve me all the signature dishes in your shop," Qiong Xiao looked at the waiter and said, then flipped over a gold coin and threw it to the waiter and said, "This is for you, go ahead."

The waiter who received the gold coins said happily: "Okay, I'll go now."

The waiter threw the towel over his shoulder, then turned around and shouted: "This guy wants all our signature dishes!"
